notes.text: The opening discusses the decompositions indexed by a_1 and a_2 and uses “bien parallèles”. The concluding line uses “non parallèles”. Both were read from ink; no mathematical repair was made. The inserted condition follows the author’s “à cela près qu’il faut exiger”.

The condition is an interlinear replacement continued in the left margin. It concerns a degree-2 vertex s, the sets U_s, E_a, E_b and nonemptiness. The separate slanted note connects its starred label to the distinctness of Pi_a and Pi_b. The label’s marks and verb ending remain unresolved.

The visualization paragraph uses arbre, script X with the pair (underlined Gamma,S), and the inserted esp. top. label attached to Gamma. The subdivision pair has S amalg A-prime under a brace labelled S-star. Neighbouring forms prompted comparisons of capitals and stars; no unseen definitions were consulted.

The NB describes A-prime through vertices of order 2, inserted pour before tte arête de X-star, the wording “une exactement”, and endpoint assignments to A-prime and S. It ends “voici une description complète des propriétés particulières aux” underlined Gamma-star, then two certain points and a possible third.

The lower paragraph cancels endings on points and coupent and the Gamma superscript, and inserts a-prime. These corrections prompted the article check; its final curl remains open. The author describes two connected components and their closures, an équateur consisting of a-prime, then a comparison of primed labels and an abbreviated modifier. The prime count and abbreviated baseline ending remain unresolved.
